soru: An information security manager has been notified about a compromised endpoint device. Which of the following is the BEST course of action to prevent further damage?
secenekler: A. Run a virus scan on the endpoint device
B. Wipe and reset the endpoint device
C. Power off the endpoint device
D. Isolate the endpoint device
dogru_cevap: D. Isolate the endpoint device

soru: During which of the following phases should an incident response team document actions required to remove the threat that caused the incident?
secenekler: A. Eradication
B. Identification
C. Containment
D. Post-incident review
dogru_cevap: A. Eradication

soru: A user reports a stolen personal mobile device that stores sensitive corporate data. Which of the following will BEST minimize the risk of data exposure?
secenekler: A. Wipe the device remotely
B. Remove user's access to corporate data
C. Prevent the user from using personal mobile devices
D. Report the incident to the police
dogru_cevap: A. Wipe the device remotely

soru: An organization has acquired a company in a foreign country to gain an advantage in a new market. Which of the following is the FIRST step the information security manager should take?
secenekler: A. Evaluate the information security laws that apply to the acquired company
B. Apply the existing information security program to the acquired company
C. Merge the two existing information security programs
D. Determine which country's information security regulations will be used
dogru_cevap: A. Evaluate the information security laws that apply to the acquired company

soru: An organization's disaster recovery plan (DRP) is documented and kept at a disaster recovery site. Which of the following is the BEST way to ensure the plan can be carried out in an emergency?
secenekler: A. Require disaster recovery documentation be stored with all key decision makers
B. Provide annual disaster recovery training to appropriate staff
C. Maintain an outsourced contact center in another country
D. Store disaster recovery documentation in a public cloud
dogru_cevap: B. Provide annual disaster recovery training to appropriate staff

soru: Which of the following is a desired outcome of information security governance?
secenekler: A. Penetration test
B. A maturity model
C. Improved risk management
D. Business agility
dogru_cevap: C. Improved risk management

soru: When designing an information security risk monitoring framework, it is MOST important to ensure:
secenekler: A. preservation of forensic evidence is enabled
B. the monitoring system is patched regularly
C. feedback is communicated to stakeholders
D. outlier events are escalated to system administrators
dogru_cevap: C. feedback is communicated to stakeholders

soru: Which of the following BEST enables staff acceptance of information security policies?
secenekler: A. Adequate security funding
B. A robust incident response program
C. Strong senior management support
D. Computer-based training
dogru_cevap: C. Strong senior management support

soru: Which of the following is the BEST way to rigorously test a disaster recovery plan (DRP) for a mission-critical system without disrupting business operations?
secenekler: A. Parallel testing
B. Simulation testing
C. Checklist review
D. Structured walk-through
dogru_cevap: A. Parallel testing

soru: An information security manager is concerned with continued security policy violations in a particular business unit despite recent efforts to rectify the situation. What is the BEST course of action?
secenekler: A. Review the business unit’s function against the policy
B. Revise the policy to accommodate the business unit
C. Report the business unit for policy noncompliance
D. Enforce sanctions on the business unit
dogru_cevap: A. Review the business unit’s function against the policy

soru: Which of the following BEST facilitates an information security manager’s efforts to obtain senior management commitment for an information security program?
secenekler: A. Presenting evidence of inherent risk
B. Reporting the security maturity level
C. Presenting compliance requirements
D. Communicating the residual risk
dogru_cevap: A. Presenting evidence of inherent risk

soru: Which of the following is PRIMARILY determined by asset classification?
secenekler: A. Priority for asset replacement
B. Level of protection required for assets
C. Replacement cost of assets
D. Insurance coverage required for assets
dogru_cevap: B. Level of protection required for assets

soru: Which of the following is MOST helpful for aligning security operations with the IT governance framework?
secenekler: A. Business impact analysis (BIA)
B. Security operations program
C. Information security policy
D. Security risk assessment
dogru_cevap: C. Information security policy

soru: An information security manager has been made aware of a new data protection regulation that will soon go into effect. Which of the following is the BEST way to manage the risk of noncompliance?
secenekler: A. Perform a gap analysis.
B. Consult with senior management on the best course of action.
C. Implement a program of work to comply with the new legislation.
D. Understand the cost of noncompliance.
dogru_cevap: A. Perform a gap analysis.

soru: An information security manager learns of a new standard related to an emerging technology the organization wants to implement. Which of the following should the information security manager recommend be done FIRST?
secenekler: A. Perform a risk assessment on the new technology.
B. Obtain legal counsel’s opinion on the standard's applicability to regulations.
C. Determine whether the organization can benefit from adopting the new standard.
D. Review industry specialists’ analyses of the new standard.
dogru_cevap: A. Perform a risk assessment on the new technology.

soru: Which of the following will provide the MOST guidance when deciding the level of protection for an information asset?
secenekler: A. Impact on information security program
B. Cost of controls
C. Impact to business function
D. Cost to replace
dogru_cevap: C. Impact to business function

soru: Which of the following BEST demonstrates return on investment (ROI) for an information security initiative?
secenekler: A. Risk heat map
B. Business impact analysis (BIA)
C. Business case
D. Information security program roadmap
dogru_cevap: C. Business case

soru: Which of the following is BEST suited to provide regular reporting to the board regarding the status of compliance to a global security standard?
secenekler: A. Legal counsel
B. Quality assurance (QA)
C. Information security
D. Internal audit
dogru_cevap: D. Internal audit

soru: Which of the following would be MOST effective in gaining senior management approval of security investments in network infrastructure?
secenekler: A. Performing penetration tests against the network to demonstrate business vulnerability
B. Highlighting competitor performance regarding network best security practices
C. Presenting comparable security implementation estimates from several vendors
D. Demonstrating that targeted security controls tie to business objectives
dogru_cevap: D. Demonstrating that targeted security controls tie to business objectives

soru: Which of the following is the MOST important reason to implement information security governance?
secenekler: A. To align the security strategy with the organization’s strategy
B. To monitor the performance of information security resources
C. To monitor the achievement of business goals and objectives
D. To provide adequate resources to achieve business goals
dogru_cevap: A. To align the security strategy with the organization’s strategy

soru: Which of the following is a PRIMARY objective of an information security governance framework?
secenekler: A. To provide the basis for action plans to achieve information security objectives organization-wide
B. To achieve the desired information security state as defined by business unit management
C. To align the relationships of stakeholders involved in developing and executing an information security strategy
D. To provide assurance that information assets are provided a level of protection proportionate to their inherent risk
dogru_cevap: A. To provide the basis for action plans to achieve information security objectives organization-wide

soru: Which of the following is the BEST way to reduce the risk associated with a bring your own device (BYOD) program?
secenekler: A. Implement a mobile device policy and standard.
B. Provide employee training on secure mobile device practices.
C. Implement a mobile device management (MDM) solution.
D. Require employees to install an effective anti-malware app.
dogru_cevap: C. Implement a mobile device management (MDM) solution.

soru: An information security manager has contracted with a company to design security architecture for an application. Which of the following is accountable for identification associated with this initiative?
secenekler: A. The project steering committee
B. The information security manager
C. The infrastructure management team
D. The application development team
dogru_cevap: B. The information security manager

soru: Which of the following desired outcomes BEST supports a decision to invest in a new security initiative?
secenekler: A. Enhanced security monitoring and reporting
B. Reduction of organizational risk
C. Reduced control complexity
D. Enhanced threat detection capability
dogru_cevap: B. Reduction of organizational risk

soru: Which of the following is an information security manager’s MOST important consideration when exploring the use of a third-party provider to handle an IT function?
secenekler: A. The provider carries cyber insurance to cover security breaches.
B. The provider agrees to provide historical security incident data.
C. The provider’s security processes align with the organization’s.
D. The provider has undergone an independent security review.
dogru_cevap: C. The provider’s security processes align with the organization’s.

soru: Which of the following MUST be defined in order for an information security manager to evaluate the appropriateness of controls currently in place?
secenekler: A) Security policy
B) Risk management framework
C) Security standards
D) Risk appetite
dogru_cevap: D) Risk appetite

soru: When an organization decides to accept a risk, it should mean the cost to mitigate:
secenekler: A) exceeds budget allocation
B) is higher than the cost to transfer risk
C) is less than the residual risk
D) is greater than the residual risk
dogru_cevap: D) is greater than the residual risk

soru: Which of the following is the MOST important reason to conduct interviews as part of the business impact analysis (BIA) process?
secenekler: A) To facilitate a qualitative risk assessment following the BIA
B) To obtain input from as many relevant stakeholders as possible
C) To ensure the stakeholders providing input own the related risk
D) To increase awareness of information security among key stakeholders
dogru_cevap: B) To obtain input from as many relevant stakeholders as possible

soru: Due to changes in an organization’s environment, security controls may no longer be adequate. What is the information security manager’s BEST course of action?
secenekler: A) Perform a new risk assessment
B) Review the previous risk assessment and countermeasures
C) Transfer the new risk to a third party
D) Evaluate countermeasures to mitigate new risks
dogru_cevap: A) Perform a new risk assessment

soru: What is the PRIMARY benefit to an organization when information security program requirements are aligned with employment and staffing processes?
secenekler: A) Access is granted based on task requirements
B) Information assets are classified appropriately
C) Security staff turnover is reduced
D) Security incident reporting procedures are followed
dogru_cevap: A) Access is granted based on task requirements

soru: When developing an asset classification program, which of the following steps should be completed FIRST?
secenekler: A) Implement a data loss prevention (DLP) system
B) Categorize each asset
C) Create a business case for a digital rights management tool
D) Create an inventory
dogru_cevap: D) Create an inventory

soru: Which of the following is the PRIMARY reason to monitor key risk indicators (KRIs) related to information security?
secenekler: A) To alert on unacceptable risk
B) To identity residual risk
C) To reassess risk appetite
D) To benchmark control performance
dogru_cevap: A) To alert on unacceptable risk

soru: Which of the following is the BEST indicator of an emerging incident?
secenekler: A) A weakness identified within an organization's information systems
B) Attempted patching of systems resulting in errors
C) Customer complaints about lack of website availability
D) A recent security incident at an industry competitor
dogru_cevap: C) Customer complaints about lack of website availability

soru: An organization has discovered a recurring problem with unsecure code being released into production. Which of the following is the information security manager action?
secenekler: A) Implement segregation of duties between development and production
B) Increase the frequency of penetration testing
C) Review existing configuration management processes
D) Review existing change management processes
dogru_cevap: A) Implement segregation of duties between development and production

soru: When developing a categorization method for security incidents, the categories MUST:
secenekler: A) be created by the incident hander
B) align with reporting requirements
C) have agreed-upon definitions
D) align with industry standards
dogru_cevap: C) have agreed-upon definitions

soru: Which of the following is MOST likely to be impacted when emerging technologies are introduced to an organization?
secenekler: A) Risk profile
B) Security policies
C) Control effectiveness
D) Risk assessment approach
dogru_cevap: A) Risk profile

soru: An organization's main product is a customer-facing application delivered using Software as a Service (SaaS). The lead security engineer has just identified a major security vulnerability at the primary cloud provider. Within the organization, who is PRIMARILY accountable for the associated risk?
secenekler: A) The data owner
B) The information security manager
C) The security engineer
D) The application owner
dogru_cevap: D) The application owner

soru: Which of the following is the MOST important criterion when deciding whether to accept residual risk?
secenekler: A) Cost of replacing the asset
B) Annual loss expectancy (ALE)
C) Cost of additional mitigation
D) Annual rate of occurrence
dogru_cevap: B) Annual loss expectancy (ALE)

soru: An information security manager finds that a soon-to-be deployed online application will increase risk beyond acceptable levels, and necessary controls have not been included. Which of the following is the BEST course of action for the information security manager?
secenekler: A) Recommend a different application
B) Instruct IT to deploy controls based on urgent business needs
C) Solicit bids for compensating control products
D) Present a business case for additional controls to senior management
dogru_cevap: D) Present a business case for additional controls to senior management

soru: When developing a business case to justify an information security investment, which of the following would BEST enable an informed decision by senior management?
secenekler: A) The information security strategy
B) Security investment trends in the industry
C) Losses due to security incidents
D) The results of a risk assessment
dogru_cevap: D) The results of a risk assessment

soru: A data-hosting organization's data center houses servers, applications, and data for a large number of geographically dispersed customers. Which of the following strategies is the BEST approach for developing a physical access control policy for the organization?
secenekler: A) Review customers’ security policies
B) Design single sign-on (SSO) or federated access
C) Develop access control requirements for each system and application
D) Conduct a risk assessment to determine security risks and mitigating controls
dogru_cevap: D) Conduct a risk assessment to determine security risks and mitigating controls

soru: Which of the following is a PRIMARY benefit of managed security solutions?
secenekler: A) Easier implementation across an organization
B) Greater ability to focus on core business operations
C) Wider range of capabilities
D) Lower cost of operations
dogru_cevap: B) Greater ability to focus on core business operations

soru: Which of the following is an example of risk mitigation?
secenekler: A) Improving security controls
B) Discontinuing the activity associated with the risk
C) Performing a cost-benefit analysis
D) Purchasing insurance
dogru_cevap: A) Improving security controls

soru: Which of the following BEST enables an organization to provide ongoing assurance that legal and regulatory compliance requirements can be met?
secenekler: A) Engaging external experts to provide guidance on changes in compliance requirements
B) Assigning the operations manager accountability for meeting compliance requirements
C) Embedding compliance requirements within operational processes
D) Performing periodic audits for compliance with legal and regulatory requirements
dogru_cevap: C) Embedding compliance requirements within operational processes

soru: Following a successful attack, an information security manager should be confident the malware has not continued to spread at the completion of which incident response phase?
secenekler: A) Recovery
B) Eradication
C) Identification
D) Containment
dogru_cevap: D) Containment

soru: Which of the following is the BEST method to align an information security strategic plan to the corporate strategy?
secenekler: A) Ensuring the plan complies with business unit expectations
B) Involving industry experts in the development of the plan
C) Involving senior management in the development of the plan
D) Obtaining adequate funds from senior management
dogru_cevap: C) Involving senior management in the development of the plan

soru: Which of the following would BEST ensure that security is integrated during application development?
secenekler: A) Performing application security testing during acceptance testing
B) Introducing security requirements during the initiation phase
C) Employing global security standards during development processes
D) Providing training on secure development practices to programmers
dogru_cevap: B) Introducing security requirements during the initiation phase

soru: Which of the following is MOST important in increasing the effectiveness of incident responders?
secenekler: A) Integrating staff with the IT department
B) Testing response scenarios
C) Communicating with the management team
D) Reviewing the incident response plan annually
dogru_cevap: B) Testing response scenarios

soru: Which of the following should be the PRIMARY objective of the information security incident response process?
secenekler: A) Classifying incidents
B) Conducting incident triage
C) Communicating with internal and external parties
D) Minimizing negative impact to critical operations
dogru_cevap: D) Minimizing negative impact to critical operations

soru: An incident response team has been assembled from a group of experienced individuals. Which type of exercise would be MOST beneficial for the team at the first drill?
secenekler: A) Tabletop exercise
B) Red team exercise
C) Disaster recovery exercise
D) Black box penetration test
dogru_cevap: A) Tabletop exercise

soru: In violation of a policy prohibiting the use of cameras at the office, employees have been issued smartphones and tablet computers with enabled web cameras. Which of the following should be the information security manager's FIRST course of action?
secenekler: A) Revise the policy
B) Conduct a risk assessment
C) Communicate the acceptable use policy
D) Perform a root cause analysis
dogru_cevap: C) Communicate the acceptable use policy

soru: When performing a business impact analysis (BIA), who should calculate the recovery time and cost estimates?
secenekler: A) Business process owner
B) Business continuity coordinator
C) Information security manager
D) Senior management
dogru_cevap: A) Business process owner

soru: A PRIMARY purpose of creating security policies is to:
secenekler: A) implement management's security governance strategy
B) establish the way security tasks should be executed
C) communicate management's security expectations
D) define allowable security boundaries
dogru_cevap: C) communicate management's security expectations

soru: The MAIN benefit of implementing a data loss prevention (DLP) solution is to:
secenekler: A) enhance the organization's antivirus controls
B) reduce the need for a security awareness program
C) complement the organization's detective controls
D) eliminate the risk of data loss
dogru_cevap: C) complement the organization's detective controls

soru: Which of the following is the MOST important detail to capture in an organization's risk register?
secenekler: A) Risk acceptance criteria
B) Risk severity level
C) Risk ownership
D) Risk appetite
dogru_cevap: C) Risk ownership

soru: Which of the following is the GREATEST benefit of information asset classification?
secenekler: A) Supporting segregation of duties
B) Defining resource ownership
C) Providing a basis for implementing a need-to-know policy
D) Helping to determine the recovery point objective (RPO)
dogru_cevap: C) Providing a basis for implementing a need-to-know policy

soru: While classifying information assets, an information security manager notices that several production databases do not have owners assigned to them. How should the information security manager address this situation?
secenekler: A) Assign the highest classification level to those databases
B) Assign responsibility to the database administrator (DBA)
C) Prepare a report of the databases for senior management
D) Review the databases for sensitive content
dogru_cevap: C) Prepare a report of the databases for senior management

soru: An organization’s research department plans to apply machine learning algorithms on a large data set containing customer names and purchase history. The risk leakage is considered high impact. Which of the following is the BEST risk treatment option in this situation?
secenekler: A) Accept the risk, as the benefits exceed the potential consequences
B) Mitigate the risk by applying anonymization on the data set
C) Transfer the risk by purchasing insurance
D) Mitigate the risk by encrypting the customer names in the data set
dogru_cevap: B) Mitigate the risk by applying anonymization on the data set

soru: IT projects have gone over budget with too many security controls being added post-production. Which of the following would MOST help to ensure that relevant security controls are integrated into a project?
secenekler: A) Involving information security at each stage of project management
B) Creating a data classification framework and providing it to stakeholders
C) Identifying responsibilities during the project business case analysis
D) Providing stakeholders with minimum information security requirements
dogru_cevap: A) Involving information security at each stage of project management

soru: Which of the following is the BEST approach to reduce unnecessary duplication of compliance activities?
secenekler: A) Integration of assurance efforts
B) Automation of controls
C) Documentation of control procedures
D) Standardization of compliance requirements
dogru_cevap: A) Integration of assurance efforts

soru: Which of the following BEST helps to ensure a risk response plan will be developed and executed in a timely manner?
secenekler: A) Establishing risk metrics
B) Training on risk management procedures
C) Reporting on documented deficiencies
D) Assigning a risk owner
dogru_cevap: D) Assigning a risk owner

soru: An information security manager learns that IT personnel are not adhering to the information security policy because it creates process inefficiencies. What should the information security manager do FIRST?
secenekler: A) Propose that IT update information security policies and procedures
B) Request that internal audit conduct a review of the policy development process
C) Conduct user awareness training within the IT function
D) Determine the risk related to noncompliance with the policy
dogru_cevap: D) Determine the risk related to noncompliance with the policy

soru: Which of the following is MOST important to include in a report to key stakeholders regarding the effectiveness of an information security program?
secenekler: A) Security incident details
B) Security metrics
C) Security risk exposure
D) Security baselines
dogru_cevap: B) Security metrics

soru: An organization is increasingly using Software as a Service (SaaS) to replace in-house hosting and support of IT applications. Which of the following would be the MOST effective way to help ensure procurement decisions consider information security concerns?
secenekler: A) Integrate information security risk assessments into the procurement process
B) Invite IT members into regular procurement team meetings to influence best practice
C) Enforce the right to audit in procurement contracts with SaaS vendors
D) Provide regular information security training to the procurement team
dogru_cevap: A) Integrate information security risk assessments into the procurement process

soru: Which of the following should be the KEY consideration when creating an information security communication plan with industry peers?
secenekler: A) Reducing the costs associated with information sharing by automating the process
B) Balancing the benefits of information sharing with the drawbacks of sharing sensitive information
C) Notifying the legal department whenever incident-related information is shared
D) Ensuring information is detailed enough to be of use to other organizations
dogru_cevap: B) Balancing the benefits of information sharing with the drawbacks of sharing sensitive information

soru: Which of the following is MOST effective for communicating forward-looking trends within security reporting?
secenekler: A) Key risk indicators (KRIs)
B) Key performance indicators (KPIs)
C) Key control indicators (KCIs)
D) Key goal indicators (KGIs)
dogru_cevap: A) Key risk indicators (KRIs)

soru: An organization recently purchased data loss prevention (DLP) software but soon discovered the software fails to detect or prevent data loss. Which of the following should the information security manager do FIRST?
secenekler: A) Revise the data classification policy
B) Review the contract
C) Review the configuration
D) Implement stricter data loss controls
dogru_cevap: C) Review the configuration

soru: Network isolation techniques are immediately implemented after a security breach to:
secenekler: A) allow time for key stakeholder decision making
B) reduce the extent of further damage
C) enforce zero trust architecture principles
D) preserve evidence as required for forensics
dogru_cevap: B) reduce the extent of further damage

soru: Which of the following incident response phases involves actions to help safeguard critical systems while maintaining business operations?
secenekler: A) Containment
B) Identification
C) Preparation
D) Recovery
dogru_cevap: A) Containment

soru: An organization has received complaints from users that some of their files have been encrypted. These users are receiving demands for money to decrypt the files. Which of the following would be the BEST course of action?
secenekler: A) Isolate the affected systems
B) Conduct an impact assessment
C) Initiate incident response
D) Rebuild the affected systems
dogru_cevap: C) Initiate incident response

soru: Which of the following has the GREATEST positive impact on the ability to execute a disaster recovery plan (DRP)?
secenekler: A) Updating the plan periodically
B) Conducting a walk-through of the plan
C) Storing the plan at an offsite location
D) Communicating the plan to all stakeholders
dogru_cevap: B) Conducting a walk-through of the plan

soru: Which of the following is MOST important to include in monthly information security reports to the board?
secenekler: A) Root cause analysis of security incidents
B) Threat intelligence
C) Risk assessment results
D) Trend analysis of security metrics
dogru_cevap: D) Trend analysis of security metrics

soru: Which of the following activities is designed to handle a control failure that leads to a breach?
secenekler: A) Vulnerability management
B) Incident management
C) Root cause analysis
D) Risk assessment
dogru_cevap: B) Incident management

soru: Which of the following is MOST important to consider when aligning a security awareness program with the organization's business strategy?
secenekler: A) Processes and technology
B) People and culture
C) Regulations and standards
D) Executive and board directives
dogru_cevap: B) People and culture

soru: Which of the following BEST indicates that information assets are classified accurately?
secenekler: A) An accurate and complete information asset catalog
B) Appropriate assignment of information asset owners
C) Appropriate prioritization of information risk treatment
D) Increased compliance with information security policy
dogru_cevap: A) An accurate and complete information asset catalog

soru: Reevaluation of risk is MOST critical when there is:
secenekler: A) a management request for updated security reports.
B) resistance to the implementation of mitigating controls.
C) a change in the threat landscape.
D) a change in security policy.
dogru_cevap: C) a change in the threat landscape.

soru: Which of the following BEST supports investments in an information security program?
secenekler: A) Business impact analysis (BIA)
B) Risk assessment results
C) Gap analysis results
D) Business cases
dogru_cevap: D) Business cases

soru: Which of the following is MOST important to ensure when developing escalation procedures for an incident response plan?
secenekler: A) Minimum regulatory requirements are maintained.
B) The contact list regularly updated.
C) Each process is assigned to a responsible party.
D) Senior management approval has been documented.
dogru_cevap: C) Each process is assigned to a responsible party.

soru: Which of the following is the PRIMARY benefit of implementing a vulnerability assessment process?
secenekler: A) Compliance status is improved.
B) Threat management is enhanced.
C) Security metrics are enhanced.
D) Proactive risk management is facilitated.
dogru_cevap: D) Proactive risk management is facilitated.

soru: An organization is implementing an information security governance framework. To communicate the program's effectiveness to stakeholders, it is MOST important to establish:
secenekler: A) a control self-assessment (CSA) process.
B) metrics for each milestone.
C) automated reporting to stakeholders.
D) a monitoring process for the security policy.
dogru_cevap: B) metrics for each milestone.

soru: Which of the following would be the MOST effective way to present quarterly reports to the board on the status of the information security program?
secenekler: A) Detailed analysis of security program KPIs
B) An information security risk register
C) An information security dashboard
D) A capability and maturity assessment
dogru_cevap: C) An information security dashboard

soru: Which of the following is the BEST way to obtain support for a new organization-wide information security program?
secenekler: A) Deliver an information security awareness campaign.
B) Publish an information security RACI chart.
C) Benchmark against similar industry organizations.
D) Establish an information security strategy committee.
dogru_cevap: D) Establish an information security strategy committee.

soru: To confirm that a third-party provider complies with an organization's information security requirements, it is MOST important to ensure:
secenekler: A) contract clauses comply with the organization's information security policy.
B) security metrics are included in the service level agreement (SLA).
C) the information security policy of the third-party service provider is reviewed.
D) right to audit is included in the service level agreement (SLA).
dogru_cevap: D) right to audit is included in the service level agreement (SLA).

soru: Which of the following BEST enables an organization to transform its culture to support information security?
secenekler: A) Strong management support
B) Robust technical security controls
C) Periodic compliance audits
D) Incentives for security incident reporting
dogru_cevap: A) Strong management support

soru: An organization is close to going live with the implementation of a cloud-based application. Independent penetration test results have been received that show a high-rated vulnerability. Which of the following would be the BEST way to proceed?
secenekler: A) Postpone the implementation until the vulnerability has been fixed.
B) Commission further penetration tests to validate initial test results.
C) Assess whether the vulnerability is within the organization's risk tolerance levels.
D) Implement the application and request the cloud service provider to fix the vulnerability.
dogru_cevap: C) Assess whether the vulnerability is within the organization's risk tolerance levels.

soru: Which of the following is the BEST way to achieve compliance with new global regulations related to the protection of personal information?
secenekler: A) Review contracts and statements of work (SOWs) with vendors.
B) Determine current and desired state of controls.
C) Execute a risk treatment plan.
D) Implement data regionalization controls.
dogru_cevap: B) Determine current and desired state of controls.

soru: Which of the following should be given the HIGHEST priority during an information security post-incident review?
secenekler: A) Evaluating incident response effectiveness
B) Documenting actions taken in sufficient detail
C) Evaluating the performance of incident response team members
D) Updating key risk indicators (KRIs)
dogru_cevap: A) Evaluating incident response effectiveness

soru: Which of the following is the BEST course of action when an online company discovers a network attack in progress?
secenekler: A) Shut off all network access points.
B) Isolate the affected network segment.
C) Dump all event logs to removable media.
D) Enable trace logging on all events.
dogru_cevap: B) Isolate the affected network segment.

soru: Which of the following is the BEST reason for an organization to use Disaster Recovery as a Service (DRaaS)?
secenekler: A) It transfers the risk associated with recovery to a third party.
B) It eliminates the need for the business to perform testing.
C) It eliminates the need to maintain offsite facilities.
D) It lowers the annual cost to the business.
dogru_cevap: C) It eliminates the need to maintain offsite facilities.

soru: When properly implemented, secure transmission protocols protect transactions:
secenekler: A) from eavesdropping.
B) in the server's database.
C) from denial of service (DoS) attacks.
D) on the client desktop.
dogru_cevap: A) from eavesdropping.

soru: An organization is in the process of acquiring a new company. Which of the following would be the BEST approach to determine how to protect newly acquired data assets prior to integration?
secenekler: A) Review data architecture.
B) Include security requirements in the contract.
C) Perform a risk assessment.
D) Assess security controls.
dogru_cevap: C) Perform a risk assessment.

soru: The PRIMARY objective of a post-incident review of an information security incident is to:
secenekler: A) minimize impact.
B) determine the impact.
C) prevent recurrence.
D) update the risk profile.
dogru_cevap: C) prevent recurrence.

soru: The MOST appropriate time to conduct a disaster recovery test would be after:
secenekler: A) the security risk profile has been reviewed.
B) major business processes have been redesigned.
C) the business continuity plan (BCP) has been updated.
D) noncompliance incidents have been filed.
dogru_cevap: C) the business continuity plan (BCP) has been updated.

soru: Which of the following methods is the BEST way to demonstrate that an information security program provides appropriate coverage?
secenekler: A) Gap assessment
B) Vulnerability scan report
C) Maturity assessment
D) Security risk analysis
dogru_cevap: D) Security risk analysis

soru: Which of the following is an information security manager's MOST important course of action when responding to a major security incident that could disrupt the business?
secenekler: A) Notify law enforcement.
B) Contact forensic investigators.
C) Follow the escalation process.
D) Identify the indicators of compromise.
dogru_cevap: C) Follow the escalation process.

soru: An information security manager determines there are a significant number of exceptions to a newly released industry-required security standard. Which of the following should be done NEXT?
secenekler: A) Document risk acceptances.
B) Conduct an information security audit.
C) Assess the consequences of noncompliance.
D) Revise the organization's security policy.
dogru_cevap: C) Assess the consequences of noncompliance.

soru: Which of the following BEST facilitates effective incident response testing?
secenekler: A) Including all business units in testing
B) Testing after major business changes
C) Simulating realistic test scenarios
D) Reviewing test results quarterly
dogru_cevap: C) Simulating realistic test scenarios

soru: Which of the following is the BEST indication of effective information security governance?
secenekler: A) Information security is considered the responsibility of the entire information security team.
B) Information security is integrated into corporate governance.
C) Information security governance is based on an external security framework.
D) Information security controls are assigned to risk owners.
dogru_cevap: B) Information security is integrated into corporate governance.

soru: The information security manager has been notified of a new vulnerability that affects key data processing systems within the organization. Which of the following should be done FIRST?
secenekler: A) Re-evaluate the risk.
B) Ask the business owner for the new remediation plan.
C) Inform senior management.
D) Implement compensating controls.
dogru_cevap: A) Re-evaluate the risk.

soru: Which of the following is the BEST way to assess the risk associated with using a Software as a Service (SaaS) vendor?
secenekler: A) Require vendors to complete information security questionnaires.
B) Request customer references from the vendor.
C) Verify that information security requirements are included in the contract.
D) Review the results of the vendor's independent control reports.
dogru_cevap: D) Review the results of the vendor's independent control reports.

soru: Security administration efforts will be greatly reduced following the deployment of which of the following techniques?
secenekler: A) Access control lists
B) Distributed access control
C) Discretionary access control
D) Role-based access control
dogru_cevap: D) Role-based access control

soru: Which of the following would be the BEST way for an information security manager to improve the effectiveness of an organization's information security program?
secenekler: A) Focus on addressing conflicts between security and performance.
B) Obtain assistance from IT to implement automated security controls.
C) Include information security requirements in the change control process.
D) Collaborate with business and IT functions in determining controls.
dogru_cevap: D) Collaborate with business and IT functions in determining controls.

soru: Which of the following should an information security manager do FIRST upon learning of noncompliance with an impending information security regulatory change?
secenekler: A) Conduct a business impact and vulnerability analysis.
B) Report the noncompliance to senior management.
C) Assess the risk and cost of noncompliance.
D) Implement the correct measures to become compliant.
dogru_cevap: C) Assess the risk and cost of noncompliance.

soru: Which of the following is MOST critical when creating an incident response plan?
secenekler: A) Identifying what constitutes an incident
B) Identifying vulnerable data assets
C) Documenting incident notification and escalation processes
D) Aligning with the risk assessment process
dogru_cevap: C) Documenting incident notification and escalation processes

soru: Which of the following would BEST help to ensure appropriate security controls are built into software?
secenekler: A) Integrating security throughout the development process
B) Performing security testing prior to deployment
C) Providing standards for implementation during development activities
D) Providing security training to the software development team
dogru_cevap: A) Integrating security throughout the development process

soru: Which of the following will BEST facilitate the integration of information security governance into enterprise governance?
secenekler: A) Implementing an information security awareness program
B) Documenting the information security governance framework
C) Developing an information security policy based on risk assessments
D) Establishing an information security steering committee
dogru_cevap: D) Establishing an information security steering committee

soru: Which of the following should an information security manager do FIRST when noncompliance with security standards is identified?
secenekler: A) Validate the noncompliance
B) Include the noncompliance in the risk register
C) Report the noncompliance to senior management
D) Implement compensating controls to mitigate the noncompliance
dogru_cevap: A) Validate the noncompliance

soru: Which of the following should be considered FIRST when recovering a compromised system that needs a complete rebuild?
secenekler: A) Network system logs
B) Intrusion detection system (IDS) logs
C) Patch management files
D) Configuration management files
dogru_cevap: D) Configuration management files

soru: When deciding to move to a cloud-based model, the FIRST consideration should be:
secenekler: A) data classification
B) physical location of the data
C) storage in a shared environment
D) availability of the data
dogru_cevap: A) data classification

soru: Which of the following is the PRIMARY objective of incident triage?
secenekler: A) Containment of threats
B) Coordination of communications
C) Categorization of events
D) Mitigation of vulnerabilities
dogru_cevap: C) Categorization of events

soru: Who is accountable for ensuring risk mitigation is effective?
secenekler: A) Application owner
B) Business owner
C) Risk owner
D) Control owner
dogru_cevap: C) Risk owner

soru: Which of the following BEST enables an information security manager to obtain organizational support for the implementation of security controls?
secenekler: A) Conducting periodic vulnerability assessments
B) Defining the organization's risk management framework
C) Communicating business impact analysis (BIA) results
D) Establishing effective stakeholder relationships
dogru_cevap: D) Establishing effective stakeholder relationships

soru: To support effective risk decision making, which of the following is MOST important to have in place?
secenekler: A) An audit committee consisting of mid-level management
B) Risk reporting procedures
C) Well-defined and approved controls
D) Established risk domains
dogru_cevap: B) Risk reporting procedures

soru: Which of the following parties should be responsible for determining access levels to an application that processes client information?
secenekler: A) The identity and access management team
B) The business client
C) The information security team
D) Business unit management
dogru_cevap: D) Business unit management

soru: What should be an information security manager's MOST important consideration when developing a multi-year plan?
secenekler: A) Ensuring contingency plans are in place for potential information security risks
B) Ensuring alignment with the plans of other business units
C) Demonstrating projected budget increases year after year
D) Allowing the information security program to expand its capabilities
dogru_cevap: B) Ensuring alignment with the plans of other business units

soru: When performing a business impact analysis (BIA), who should be responsible for determining the initial recovery time objective (RTO)?
secenekler: A) Information security manager
B) External consultant
C) Business continuity coordinator
D) Information owner
dogru_cevap: D) Information owner

soru: Which of the following will ensure confidentiality of content when accessing an email system over the Internet?
secenekler: A) Digital encryption
B) Multi-factor authentication
C) Digital signatures
D) Data masking
dogru_cevap: A) Digital encryption

soru: Who is BEST suited to determine how the information in a database should be classified?
secenekler: A) Information security analyst
B) Database analyst
C) Database administrator (DBA)
D) Data owner
dogru_cevap: D) Data owner

soru: Which of the following is an incident containment method?
secenekler: A) Reviewing system logs and audit trails
B) Removing compromised systems from the network
C) Analyzing systems for impact from the incident
D) Mapping the scope of the incident on the network
dogru_cevap: B) Removing compromised systems from the network

soru: A CISO learns that a third-party service provider did not notify the organization of a data breach that affected the service provider's data center. Which of the following should the CISO do FIRST?
secenekler: A) Determine the extent of the impact to the organization.
B) Request an independent review of the provider's data center.
C) Notify affected customers of the data breach.
D) Recommend canceling the outsourcing contract.
dogru_cevap: A) Determine the extent of the impact to the organization.

soru: Which of the following is MOST important to include in an incident response plan to ensure incidents are responded to by the appropriate individuals?
secenekler: A) Skills required for the incident response team
B) A detailed incident notification process
C) A list of external resources to assist with incidents
D) Service level agreements (SLAs)
dogru_cevap: B) A detailed incident notification process

soru: Which of the following is the PRIMARY role of an information security manager in a software development project?
secenekler: A) To identify software security weaknesses
B) To identify noncompliance in the early design stage
C) To assess and approve the security application architecture
D) To enhance awareness for secure software design
dogru_cevap: C) To assess and approve the security application architecture

soru: Which of the following MOST effectively identifies issues related to noncompliance with legal, regulatory, and contractual requirements?
secenekler: A) Compliance maturity assessment
B) Compliance benchmarking data
C) Compliance gap analysis
D) Independent compliance audit
dogru_cevap: D) Independent compliance audit

soru: Which of the following is MOST helpful for fostering an effective information security culture?
secenekler: A) Obtaining support from key organizational influencers
B) Implementing comprehensive technical security controls
C) Conducting regular information security awareness training
D) Developing procedures to enforce the information security policy
dogru_cevap: C) Conducting regular information security awareness training

soru: Which of the following is the GREATEST benefit resulting from the introduction of data security standards for payment cards?
secenekler: A) It helps achieve the holistic protection of information assets in the industry.
B) It deters hackers from committing crimes related to card payments.
C) It enables a wider range of more sophisticated payment methods.
D) It optimizes budget allocation for cybersecurity in each organization.
dogru_cevap: A) It helps achieve the holistic protection of information assets in the industry.

soru: Which of the following is the PRIMARY objective of integrating information security governance into corporate governance?
secenekler: A) To align security goals with the information security program
B) To ensure the business supports information security goals
C) To adequately safeguard the business in achieving its mission
D) To obtain management commitment for sustaining the security program
dogru_cevap: C) To adequately safeguard the business in achieving its mission

soru: Which of the following is an information security manager's MOST important action to mitigate the risk associated with malicious software?
secenekler: A) Disabling end-user computer peripheral access ports
B) Implementing a multi-layered security program
C) Ensuring antivirus has the latest definition files
D) Strengthening security patch implementation processes
dogru_cevap: B) Implementing a multi-layered security program

soru: Which of the following is the PRIMARY reason for granting a security exception?
secenekler: A) The risk is justified by the cost to security.
B) The risk is justified by the benefit to security.
C) The risk is justified by the benefit to the business.
D) The risk is justified by the cost to the business.
dogru_cevap: C) The risk is justified by the benefit to the business.

soru: Which of the following is MOST effective in preventing the introduction of vulnerabilities that may disrupt the availability of a critical business application?
secenekler: A) A patch management process
B) Change management controls
C) Version control
D) Logical access controls
dogru_cevap: B) Change management controls

soru: An organization is planning to outsource the execution of its disaster recovery activities. Which of the following would be MOST important to include in the outsourcing agreement?
secenekler: A) Requirements for regularly testing backups
B) The disaster recovery communication plan
C) Recovery time objectives (RTOs)
D) Definition of when a disaster should be declared
dogru_cevap: D) Definition of when a disaster should be declared

soru: Which type of plan is PRIMARILY intended to reduce the potential impact of security events that may occur?
secenekler: A) Incident response plan
B) Business continuity plan (BCP)
C) Security awareness plan
D) Disaster recovery plan (DRP)
dogru_cevap: A) Incident response plan

soru: Which of the following is the MOST important outcome of strategic alignment of corporate and information security governance?
secenekler: A) Implementation of information security controls
B) Development of a common and comprehensive set of IT security policies
C) Higher acceptance of information security projects
D) Reduction of adverse impacts on the organization to an acceptable level
dogru_cevap: D) Reduction of adverse impacts on the organization to an acceptable level

soru: Which of the following is MOST important to have in place as a basis for developing an effective information security program that supports the organization's business goals?
secenekler: A) An information security strategy
B) A defined security organizational structure
C) Information security policies
D) Metrics to drive the information security program
dogru_cevap: A) An information security strategy

soru: Which of the following BEST enables the integration of information security governance into corporate governance?
secenekler: A) Senior management approval of the information security strategy
B) Clear lines of authority across the organization
C) An information security steering committee with business representation
D) Well-documented information security policies and standards
dogru_cevap: C) An information security steering committee with business representation

soru: Which of the following contributes MOST to the effectiveness of information security governance?
secenekler: A) Properly managed risk
B) Alignment with technology strategy
C) Stakeholder commitment
D) A defined security policy
dogru_cevap: C) Stakeholder commitment

soru: Which of the following is the BEST approach for addressing noncompliance with security standards?
secenekler: A) Maintain a security exceptions process.
B) Apply additional logging and monitoring to affected assets.
C) Discontinue affected activities until security requirements can be met.
D) Develop new security standards.
dogru_cevap: A) Maintain a security exceptions process.

soru: Which of the following is the BEST method for managing information security compliance of third-party suppliers?
secenekler: A) Develop specific information security policies for third parties.
B) Conduct a vulnerability assessment of the third-party supplier.
C) Include third-party supplier details in the risk register.
D) Ensure information security requirements are addressed in the contract.
dogru_cevap: D) Ensure information security requirements are addressed in the contract.

soru: An organization is in the process of creating an agreement with a cloud provider. Who should determine the third party's destruction schedule for the organization's information?
secenekler: A) The organization's information security manager
B) The cloud provider's information security manager
C) The organization's data owner
D) The cloud provider's data custodian
dogru_cevap: C) The organization's data owner

soru: Which of the following is the BEST course of action when an organization's incident response team does not have expertise in forensic analysis?
secenekler: A) Contract with external forensic experts.
B) Develop forensic analysis procedures.
C) Document the shortcoming.
D) Acquire forensic analysis tools.
dogru_cevap: A) Contract with external forensic experts.

soru: What should be the FIRST step when investigating an employee suspected of inappropriately downloading proprietary information?
secenekler: A) Check for a signed nondisclosure agreement (NDA).
B) Review system access logs.
C) Conduct a forensic examination of the device.
D) Discuss the concern with the employee.
dogru_cevap: B) Review system access logs.

soru: Which of the following is MOST critical to ensure that information security incidents are managed properly?
secenekler: A) Conducting an incident capability maturity assessment
B) Testing the incident response plan
C) Establishing an incident management performance matrix
D) Assembling the incident response team
dogru_cevap: B) Testing the incident response plan

soru: The GREATEST challenge when attempting data recovery of a specific file during forensic analysis is when:
secenekler: A) high-level disk formatting has been performed.
B) all files in the directory have been deleted.
C) the partition table on the disk has been deleted.
D) the file has been overwritten.
dogru_cevap: D) the file has been overwritten.

soru: Which of the following is MOST helpful in determining the criticality of an organization's business functions?
secenekler: A) Disaster recovery plan (DRP)
B) Business continuity plan (BCP)
C) Security assessment report (SAR)
D) Business impact analysis (BIA)
dogru_cevap: D) Business impact analysis (BIA)

soru: The contribution of recovery point objective (RPO) to disaster recovery is to:
secenekler: A) eliminate single points of failure.
B) reduce mean time between failures (MTBF).
C) define backup strategy.
D) minimize outage periods.
dogru_cevap: C) define backup strategy.

soru: An information security manager is MOST likely to obtain approval for a new security project when the business case provides evidence of:
secenekler: A) threats to the organization.
B) organizational alignment.
C) existing control costs.
D) IT strategy alignment.
dogru_cevap: B) organizational alignment.

soru: Which of the following should be established FIRST when implementing an Information security governance framework?
secenekler: A) Security incident management learn
B) Security policies
C) Security architecture
D) Security awareness training program
dogru_cevap: B) Security policies

soru: An information security team is planning a security assessment of an existing vendor. Which of the following approaches is MOST helpful for properly scoping the assessment?
secenekler: A) Review the vendor’s security policy.
B) Review controls listed in the vendor contract.
C) Focus the review on the infrastructure with the highest risk.
D) Determine whether the vendor follows the selected security framework rules.
dogru_cevap: B) Review controls listed in the vendor contract.

soru: A third-party audit of an organization's network security has identified several critical risks. Which of the following should the information security manager do NEXT?
secenekler: A) Assign risk ownership.
B) Identify mitigating controls.
C) Report the findings to senior management.
D) Prioritize the risks.
dogru_cevap: D) Prioritize the risks.

soru: Which of the following provides the BEST evidence that a recently established information security program is effective?
secenekler: A) The number of reported incidents has increased.
B) Regular IT balanced scorecards are communicated.
C) The number of tickets associated with IT incidents have stayed consistent.
D) Senior management has reported fewer junk emails.
dogru_cevap: A) The number of reported incidents has increased.

soru: An investigation of a recent security incident determined that the root cause was negligent handling of incident alerts by system administrators. What is the BEST way for the information security manager to address this issue?
secenekler: A) Provide incident response training to data owners.
B) Provide incident response training to data custodians.
C) Conduct a risk assessment and share the results with senior management.
D) Revise the incident response plan to align with business processes.
dogru_cevap: B) Provide incident response training to data custodians.

soru: An organization is the victim or a targeted attack and is unaware of the compromise until a security analyst notices an additional user account on the firewall. The implementation of which of the following would have detected the incident?
secenekler: A) Web-application firewall
B) Security information and event management (SIEM)
C) Data leakage prevention (DLP)
D) Network access control
dogru_cevap: B) Security information and event management (SIEM)

soru: Of the following, who is accountable for data loss in the event of an information security incident at a third-party provider?
secenekler: A) The information security manager
B) The service provider that hosts the data
C) The incident response team
D) The business data owner
dogru_cevap: D) The business data owner

soru: Which of the following BEST minimizes information security risk in deploying applications to the production environment?
secenekler: A) Conducting penetration testing post implementation
B) Having a well-defined change process
C) Verifying security during the testing process
D) Integrating security controls in each phase of the life cycle
dogru_cevap: D) Integrating security controls in each phase of the life cycle

soru: Which of the following would BEST guide the development and maintenance of an information security program?
secenekler: A) A business impact assessment
B) The organization's risk appetite
C) A comprehensive risk register
D) An established risk assessment process
dogru_cevap: B) The organization's risk appetite

soru: Which of the following BEST indicates effective information security governance?
secenekler: A) Availability of information security policies
B) Regular steering committee meetings
C) Organization-wide attendance at annual security training
D) Regular testing of the security incident response plan
dogru_cevap: B) Regular steering committee meetings

soru: The MOST useful technique for maintaining management support for the information security program is:
secenekler: A) informing management about the security of business operations.
B) identifying the risks and consequences of failure to comply with standards.
C) benchmarking the security programs of comparable organizations.
D) implementing a comprehensive security awareness and training program.
dogru_cevap: A) informing management about the security of business operations.

soru: When remote access is granted to a company's internal network, the MOST important consideration should be that access is provided:
secenekler: A) by the use of a remote access server.
B) if a robust IT infrastructure exists.
C) subject to legal and regulatory requirements.
D) on a need-to-know basis subject to controls.
dogru_cevap: D) on a need-to-know basis subject to controls.

soru: Which of the following should be triggered FIRST when unknown malware has infected an organization's critical system?
secenekler: A) Disaster recovery plan (DRP)
B) Vulnerability management plan
C) Incident response plan
D) Business continuity plan (BCP)
dogru_cevap: C) Incident response plan

soru: Which of the following is the FIRST step in developing a business impact analysis (BIA)?
secenekler: A) Identifying interdependencies among critical functions within the business
B) Determining the minimum resources needed for recovery
C) Identifying which business functions are critical to the organization
D) Determining the required recovery time objective (RTO) of business operations
dogru_cevap: C) Identifying which business functions are critical to the organization

soru: Which of the following is MOST important when defining how an information security budget should be allocated?
secenekler: A) Business impact assessment
B) Regulatory compliance standards
C) Information security strategy
D) Information security policy
dogru_cevap: C) Information security strategy

soru: A forensic examination of a PC is required, but the PC has been switched off. Which of the following should be done FIRST?
secenekler: A) Perform a backup of the computer using the network.
B) Perform a bit-by-bit backup of the hard disk using a write-blocking device.
C) Reboot the system using third-party forensic software in the CD-ROM drive.
D) Perform a backup of the hard drive using backup utilities.
dogru_cevap: B) Perform a bit-by-bit backup of the hard disk using a write-blocking device.

soru: Which of the following should an organization do FIRST when confronted with the transfer of personal data across borders?
secenekler: A) Define policies and standards for data processing.
B) Implement applicable privacy principles.
C) Research cyber insurance policies.
D) Assess local or regional regulation.
dogru_cevap: D) Assess local or regional regulation.

soru: Which of the following BEST enables an organization to measure the total time that operations can be sustained at an alternative site designated in the business continuity plan (BCP)?
secenekler: A) Recovery point objective (RPO)
B) Allowable interruption window (AIW)
C) Maximum tolerable outage (MTO)
D) Recovery time objective (RTO)
dogru_cevap: C) Maximum tolerable outage (MTO)

soru: Which of the following has the GREATEST influence on the successful integration of information security within the business?
secenekler: A) Organizational structure and culture
B) Risk tolerance and organizational objectives
C) Information security personnel
D) The desired state of the organization
dogru_cevap: B) Risk tolerance and organizational objectives

soru: Which of the following is the MOST important consideration to support potential legal action when responding to a security incident?
secenekler: A) Contacting the appropriate law enforcement agency
B) Encrypting the documentation being assembled
C) Maintaining chain-of-custody of evidence
D) Preparing full forensic system backups
dogru_cevap: C) Maintaining chain-of-custody of evidence

soru: An incident response team has established that an application has been breached. Which of the following should be done NEXT?
secenekler: A) Maintain the affected systems in a forensically acceptable state.
B) Inform senior management of the breach.
C) Isolate the impacted systems from the rest of the network.
D) Conduct a risk assessment on the affected application.
dogru_cevap: C) Isolate the impacted systems from the rest of the network.

soru: A daily monitoring report reveals that an IT employee made a change to a firewall rule outside of the change control process. The information security manager's FIRST step in addressing the issue should be to:
secenekler: A) perform an analysis of the change.
B) report the event to senior management.
C) require that the change be reversed.
D) review the change management process.
dogru_cevap: A) perform an analysis of the change.

soru: Which of the following BEST facilitates the reporting of useful information about the effectiveness of the information security program?
secenekler: A) Security benchmark report
B) Risk heat map
C) Security metrics dashboard
D) Key risk indicators (KRIs)
dogru_cevap: C) Security metrics dashboard

soru: Which of the following BEST mitigates the risk or information loss caused by a cloud service provider becoming insolvent?
secenekler: A) Contractual provisions for the right to audit
B) Effective data loss prevention (DLP) controls
C) Contractual provisions for data repatriation
D) The purchasing of cybersecurity insurance
dogru_cevap: C) Contractual provisions for data repatriation

soru: An information security team has been tasked with identifying confidential data within the organization to formalize its asset classification scheme. The MOST relevant input would be provided by:
secenekler: A) business process owners.
B) the legal department.
C) the chief information officer (CIO).
D) database administrators (DBAs).
dogru_cevap: A) business process owners.

soru: Which of the following is the PRIMARY reason to conduct a post-incident review?
secenekler: A) To determine whether digital evidence is admissible
B) To notify regulatory authorities
C) To improve the response process
D) To aid in future risk assessments
dogru_cevap: C) To improve the response process

soru: Which of the following is the BEST way to protect against unauthorized access to an encrypted file sent via email?
secenekler: A) Validating the recipient's identity
B) Using a digital signature in the email
C) Utilizing a separate distribution channel for the password
D) Ensuring a policy exists for encrypting files in transit
dogru_cevap: C) Utilizing a separate distribution channel for the password

soru: The PRIMARY purpose of implementing information security governance metrics is to:
secenekler: A) measure alignment with best practices.
B) refine control operations.
C) assess operational and program metrics.
D) guide security towards the desired state.
dogru_cevap: D) guide security towards the desired state.

soru: Which of the following roles is PRIMARILY responsible for developing an information classification framework based on business needs?
secenekler: A) Information owner
B) Information security steering committee
C) Senior management
D) Information security manager
dogru_cevap: C) Senior management

soru: Which of the following should be done FIRST when developing an information security strategy?
secenekler: A) Establish information security steering committee.
B) Determine the desired state of information security.
C) Develop security policies and standards.
D) Identity owners of information assets.
dogru_cevap: B) Determine the desired state of information security.

soru: A business impact analysis (BIA) should be periodically executed PRIMARILY to:
secenekler: A) verify the effectiveness of controls.
B) check compliance with regulations.
C) validate vulnerabilities on environmental changes.
D) analyze the importance of assets.
dogru_cevap: D) analyze the importance of assets.

soru: While responding to a high-profile security incident, an information security manager observed several deficiencies in the current incident response plan. When would be the BEST time to update the plan?
secenekler: A) While responding to the incident
B) During post-incident review
C) During a tabletop exercise
D) After a risk reassessment
dogru_cevap: B) During post-incident review

soru: Which of the following BEST enables an information security manager to demonstrate the effectiveness of the information security and risk program to senior management?
secenekler: A) Updated risk assessments
B) Audit reports
C) Counts of information security incidents
D) Monthly metrics
dogru_cevap: D) Monthly metrics

soru: Which of the following would BEST justify spending for a compensating control?
secenekler: A) Root cause analysis
B) Emerging risk trends
C) Vulnerability assessment
D) Risk analysis
dogru_cevap: D) Risk analysis

soru: Which or the following is the BEST way to monitor for advanced persistent threats (APT) in an organization?
secenekler: A) Browse the Internet to learn of potential events.
B) Search for threat signatures in the environment.
C) Search for anomalies in the environment.
D) Network with peers in the industry to share information.
dogru_cevap: C) Search for anomalies in the environment.

soru: In response to recent ransomware threats, an organization deployed a new endpoint detection and response (EDR) solution in its employee laptops. Of the following, who should be accountable for reviewing the solution to verify it has been properly deployed and configured?
secenekler: A) The security analyst
B) The chief audit executive (CAE)
C) The chief information security officer (CISO)
D) The system administrator
dogru_cevap: C) The chief information security officer (CISO)

soru: An organization's quality process can BEST support security management by providing:
secenekler: A) a repository for security systems documentation.
B) assurance that security requirements are met.
C) guidance for security strategy.
D) security configuration controls.
dogru_cevap: B) assurance that security requirements are met.

soru: Which of the following is the MOST important consideration when defining an information security framework?
secenekler: A) Information security budget
B) Industry standards
C) Business strategy
D) Organizational culture
dogru_cevap: C) Business strategy

soru: Which of the following is the MOST important consideration for reporting risk assessment results to senior management?
secenekler: A) The reports should include comparisons to industry benchmarks.
B) The reports should be presented in business terms.
C) The reports should use formal methodologies.
D) The reports should include recommended controls.
dogru_cevap: B) The reports should be presented in business terms.

soru: Which of the following is the BEST way to determine the effectiveness of an incident response plan?
secenekler: A) Reviewing previous audit reports
B) Benchmarking the plan against best practices
C) Performing a penetration test
D) Conducting a tabletop exercise
dogru_cevap: D) Conducting a tabletop exercise

soru: Which of the following should be an information security manager's MOST important consideration when determining the priority for implementing security controls?
secenekler: A) Availability of security budget
B) Alignment with industry benchmarks
C) Results of business impact analyses (BIAs)
D) Possibility of reputational loss due to incidents
dogru_cevap: C) Results of business impact analyses (BIAs)

soru: Which of the following is the PRIMARY reason for an information security manager to periodically review existing controls?
secenekler: A) To prioritize security initiatives
B) To avoid redundant controls
C) To align with emerging risk
D) To address end-user control complaints
dogru_cevap: C) To align with emerging risk

soru: Which of the following should be done FIRST when implementing a security program?
secenekler: A) Implement data encryption.
B) Perform a risk analysis.
C) Create an information asset inventory.
D) Determine the value of information assets.
dogru_cevap: C) Create an information asset inventory.

soru: Of the following, who is MOST appropriate to own the risk associated with the failure of a privileged access control?
secenekler: A) Data owner
B) Information security manager
C) Business owner
D) Compliance manager
dogru_cevap: C) Business owner

soru: Which of the following is an example of a deterrent control?
secenekler: A) Segregation of responsibilities
B) A warning banner
C) An intrusion detection system (IDS)
D) Periodic data restoration
dogru_cevap: B) A warning banner

soru: An information security manager has completed a risk assessment and has determined the residual risk. Which of the following should be the NEXT step?
secenekler: A) Implement countermeasures to mitigate risk.
B) Classify all identified risks.
C) Conduct an evaluation of controls.
D) Determine if the risk is within the risk appetite.
dogru_cevap: D) Determine if the risk is within the risk appetite.

soru: Which of the following BEST enables an organization to maintain an appropriate security control environment?
secenekler: A) Periodic employee security training
B) Budgetary support for security
C) Alignment to an industry security framework
D) Monitoring of the threat landscape
dogru_cevap: D) Monitoring of the threat landscape

soru: Which of the following is MOST important for responding effectively to security breaches?
secenekler: A) Chain of custody
B) Incident classification
C) Log monitoring
D) Communication plan
dogru_cevap: B) Incident classification

soru: Which of the following is the BEST method for assisting with incident containment in an Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) cloud environment?
secenekler: A) Disabling unnecessary services
B) Implementing privileged identity management
C) Establishing automated detection
D) Implementing network segmentation
dogru_cevap: D) Implementing network segmentation

soru: Which of the following should be performed FIRST in response to a new information security regulation?
secenekler: A) Industry benchmarking
B) Independent audit
C) Risk assessment
D) Gap analysis
dogru_cevap: D) Gap analysis

soru: To ensure the information security of outsourced IT services, which of the following is the MOST critical due diligence activity?
secenekler: A) Assess the level of security awareness of the service provider.
B) Review a recent independent audit report of the service provider.
C) Review samples of service level reports from the service provider.
D) Request the service provider comply with information security policy.
dogru_cevap: B) Review a recent independent audit report of the service provider.

soru: Which of the following is the MOST important reason to consider organizational culture when developing an information security program?
secenekler: A) It helps expedite approval for the information security budget.
B) It helps the organization meet compliance requirements.
C) Everyone in the organization is responsible for information security.
D) Security incidents have an adverse impact on the entire organization.
dogru_cevap: C) Everyone in the organization is responsible for information security.

soru: Which of the following processes BEST supports the evaluation of incident response effectiveness?
secenekler: A) Post-incident review
B) Chain of custody
C) Incident logging
D) Root cause analysis
dogru_cevap: A) Post-incident review

soru: Which of the following should an information security manager do FIRST after learning through mass media of a data breach at the organization's hosted payroll service provider?
secenekler: A) Validate the breach with the provider.
B) Suspend the data exchange with the provider.
C) Notify appropriate regulatory authorities of the breach.
D) Initiate the business continuity plan (BCP).
dogru_cevap: A) Validate the breach with the provider.

soru: Which of the following should an information security manager do FIRST after discovering that a business unit has implemented a newly purchased application and bypassed the change management process?
secenekler: A) Update the change management process.
B) Revise the procurement process.
C) Discuss the issue with senior leadership.
D) Remove the application from production.
dogru_cevap: C) Discuss the issue with senior leadership.

soru: An organization is strategizing on how to improve security awareness. Which of the following is MOST important to consider when developing this strategy?
secenekler: A) Technical solutions for delivery
B) Cost to implement
C) Organizational culture
D) Organizational maturity
dogru_cevap: C) Organizational culture

soru: A penetration test against an organization's external web application shows several vulnerabilities. Which of the following presents the GREATEST concern?
secenekler: A) Vulnerabilities were caused by insufficient user acceptance testing (UAT).
B) Exploit code for one of the vulnerabilities is publicly available.
C) Rules of engagement form was not signed prior to the penetration test.
D) Vulnerabilities were not found by internal tests.
dogru_cevap: B) Exploit code for one of the vulnerabilities is publicly available.

soru: Which of the following is the GREATEST concern resulting from the lack of severity criteria in incident classification?
secenekler: A) The service desk will be staffed incorrectly.
B) Timely detection of attacks will be impossible.
C) Statistical reports will be incorrect.
D) Escalation procedures will be ineffective.
dogru_cevap: D) Escalation procedures will be ineffective.

soru: Which of the following would be the BEST way to maintain organization-wide support for an information security strategy?
secenekler: A) Ensure information security objectives are understood by key stakeholders.
B) Monitor user activity to identify and track information security policy violations.
C) Place information security awareness materials in visible locations.
D) Ensure information security policies are easily accessible.
dogru_cevap: A) Ensure information security objectives are understood by key stakeholders.

soru: Several critical systems have been compromised with malware. Which of the following is the BEST strategy to eradicate this incident?
secenekler: A) Reimage the systems.
B) Block access to the impacted systems.
C) Perform malware scanning.
D) Perform a vulnerability assessment.
dogru_cevap: A) Reimage the systems.

soru: Which of the following is the MOST important success factor for maintaining an organizational security-aware culture?
secenekler: A) Senior management sign-off on security projects and resources
B) Regular security training and simulation exercises
C) Regular organization-wide reporting on the risk profile
D) Employee security policy acknowledgment
dogru_cevap: B) Regular security training and simulation exercises

soru: Senior management has expressed concern that the organization's intrusion prevention system (IPS) may repeatedly disrupt business operations. Which of the following BEST indicates that the information security manager has tuned the system to address this concern?
secenekler: A) Decreasing false positives
B) Decreasing false negatives
C) Increasing false negatives
D) Increasing false positives
dogru_cevap: A) Decreasing false positives

soru: Which of the following metrics would BEST monitor how well information security requirements are incorporated into the change management process?
secenekler: A) Information security incidents caused due to unauthorized changes
B) Unauthorized changes in the environment
C) Denied changes due to insufficient security details
D) Information security-related changes
