C) To ensure compensating controls are in place for key information assets
D) To reduce threats associated with business data processing
dogru_cevap: B) To ensure business data processing has been assessed for risk

soru: When reporting information security risk to senior management, it is MOST important to include:
secenekler: A) control risk.
B) inherent risk.
C) detection risk.
D) residual risk.
dogru_cevap: D) residual risk.

soru: Which of the following is MOST likely to improve an organization's security culture?
secenekler: A) Involving stakeholders in security planning
B) Enforcing penalties for security incidents
C) Communicating security incidents within the industry
D) Incentivizing managers based on security metrics
dogru_cevap: A) Involving stakeholders in security planning

soru: Which of the following is MOST important to complete during the recovery phase of an incident response process before bringing affected systems back online?
secenekler: A) Test and verify that compromised systems are clean.
B) Document recovery steps for senior management reporting.
C) Record and close security incident tickets.
D) Capture and preserve forensic images of affected systems.
dogru_cevap: A) Test and verify that compromised systems are clean.

soru: What is the BEST way for an information security manager to improve the effectiveness of risk management in an organization that currently manages risk at the departmental level?
secenekler: A) Deploy security risk management software in all departments.
B) Determine whether the organization has defined its risk tolerance and risk appetite.
C) Subscribe to external risk reports relevant to each department.
D) Propose that security risk be integrated under a common risk register.
dogru_cevap: D) Propose that security risk be integrated under a common risk register.

soru: Which of the following is MOST helpful to an information security manager when determining service level requirements for an outsourced application?
secenekler: A) Supplier business continuity plan (BCP)
B) Information security policy
C) Application capabilities
D) Data classification
dogru_cevap: D) Data classification

soru: Which of the following is MOST important to consider when planning the eradication of a cyberattack?
secenekler: A) The skills and competencies of the eradication team
B) The cost of tools and efforts required for the process
C) Obtain a clean backup of the operating system
D) Knowledge about the type and source of the threat
dogru_cevap: D) Knowledge about the type and source of the threat

soru: Which of the following BEST enables an information security manager to identify changes in the threat landscape due to emerging technologies?
secenekler: A) Input from external experts
B) Annual security assessments
C) Periodic risk assessments
D) Benchmarking against industry peers
dogru_cevap: A) Input from external experts

soru: An enterprise has decided to procure security services from a third-party vendor to support its information security program. Which of the following is MOST important to include in the vendor selection criteria?
secenekler: A) The maturity of the vendor's internal control environment
B) Feedback from the vendor's previous clients
C) Alignment of the vendor's business objectives with enterprise security goals
D) Penetration testing against the vendor's network
dogru_cevap: C) Alignment of the vendor's business objectives with enterprise security goals

soru: The resilience requirements of an application are BEST determined by:
secenekler: A) a cost-benefit analysis.
B) a threat assessment.
C) a business impact analysis (BIA).
D) a risk assessment.
dogru_cevap: C) a business impact analysis (BIA).

soru: Which of the following BEST facilitates recovery of data lost as a result of a cybersecurity incident?
secenekler: A) Disaster recovery plan (DRP)
B) Offsite data backups
C) Encrypted data drives
D) Removable storage media
dogru_cevap: B) Offsite data backups

soru: Which of the following is MOST important to the successful implementation of a new information security program?
secenekler: A) Evaluating current information security processes
B) Gaining commitment from senior management
C) Conducting regular external benchmarking
D) Monitoring key performance indicators (KPIs)
dogru_cevap: B) Gaining commitment from senior management

soru: An information security team has confirmed that threat actors are taking advantage of a newly announced critical vulnerability within an application. Which of the following should be done FIRST?
secenekler: A) Notify senior management.
B) Prevent access to the application.
C) Invoke the incident response plan.
D) Install additional application controls.
dogru_cevap: C) Invoke the incident response plan.

soru: Which of the following is the MOST important consideration when evaluating the performance of existing security controls?
secenekler: A) Interviewing control owners to accurately collect metrics data
B) Establishing testing scenarios based on international standards
C) Selecting testing methods that match the purpose of the testing
D) Obtaining senior management support to facilitate testing
dogru_cevap: C) Selecting testing methods that match the purpose of the testing

soru: Which of the following metrics BEST demonstrates the effectiveness of an organization's security awareness program?
secenekler: A) Percentage of employee computers and devices infected with malware
B) Percentage of employees who regularly attend security training
C) Number of security incidents reported to the help desk
D) Number of phishing emails viewed by end users
dogru_cevap: C) Number of security incidents reported to the help desk

soru: Who should decide whether a specific control should be changed once risk is approved for mitigation?
secenekler: A) Risk owner
B) Data owner
C) Control owner
D) Process owner
dogru_cevap: A) Risk owner

soru: When determining key risk indicators (KRIs) for use in an information security program it is MOST important to select:
secenekler: A) KRIs that track both short-term and long-term performance.
B) KRIs that align with business processes.
C) KRIs that are quantifiable.
D) as many KRIs as possible to catch risk events from the broadest areas.
dogru_cevap: B) KRIs that align with business processes.

soru: Senior management has requested a budget cut for the information security program in the coming fiscal year. Which of the following should be the information security manager's FIRST course of action?
secenekler: A) Analyze the impact to the information security program.
B) Advise business unit heads of potential changes to the information security program.
C) Evaluate cost savings within existing implementations.
D) Re-prioritize information security implementation and operations.
dogru_cevap: A) Analyze the impact to the information security program.

soru: What is the MOST important consideration when establishing metrics for reporting to the information security strategy committee?
secenekler: A) Benchmarking the expected value of the metrics against industry standards
B) Aligning the metrics with the organizational culture
C) Agreeing on baseline values for the metrics
D) Developing a dashboard for communicating the metrics
dogru_cevap: B) Aligning the metrics with the organizational culture

soru: Which of the following presents the GREATEST challenge when assessing the impact of emerging risk?
secenekler: A) Outdated risk management strategy
B) Insufficient data related to the emerging risk
C) Complexity of the emerging risk
D) Lack of resources to perform risk assessments
dogru_cevap: B) Insufficient data related to the emerging risk

soru: To effectively manage an organization’s information security risk, it is MOST important to:
secenekler: A) establish and communicate risk tolerance.
B) benchmark risk scenarios against peer organizations.
C) assign risk management responsibility to an experienced consultant.
D) periodically identify and correct new systems vulnerabilities.
dogru_cevap: A) establish and communicate risk tolerance.

soru: Which of the following is the MOST useful input for an information security manager when updating the organization’s security policy?
secenekler: A) Security team capabilities
B) Risk appetite
C) Vulnerability scan
D) Industry best practices
dogru_cevap: B) Risk appetite

soru: The MOST effective way for an information security manager to secure senior management support for the information security strategy is by:
secenekler: A) presenting industry-specific information security best practices.
B) determining cost effective information security controls.
C) educating management on information security program needs.
D) developing reports showing current threats to the organization.
dogru_cevap: C) educating management on information security program needs.

soru: When engaging an external party to perform a penetration test, it is MOST important to:
secenekler: A) provide an updated asset inventory.
B) notify employees of the testing.
C) define the project scope.
D) provide network documentation.
dogru_cevap: C) define the project scope.

soru: Which of the following is the MOST effective way to convey information security responsibilities across an organization?
secenekler: A) Implementing security awareness programs
B) Defining information security responsibilities in the security policy
C) Developing a skills matrix
D) Documenting information security responsibilities within job descriptions
dogru_cevap: D) Documenting information security responsibilities within job descriptions

soru: A financial institution is expanding to international jurisdictions and is mindful of protecting customer information. Which of the following should be of GREATEST concern?
secenekler: A) Ability to monitor and enforce security controls in multiple jurisdictions
B) Global payment card industry regulations
C) Privacy laws and regulations for each country in which the organization operates
D) Information security resources available in each country in which the organization operates
dogru_cevap: C) Privacy laws and regulations for each country in which the organization operates

soru: When evaluating cloud storage solutions, the FIRST consideration should be:
secenekler: A) how the organization's sensitive data will be transferred.
B) the service level agreement (SLA) for encryption keys.
C) the volume of data to be stored in the cloud.
D) alignment with the organization's data classification policy.
dogru_cevap: D) alignment with the organization's data classification policy.

soru: Which of the following is the GREATEST benefit resulting from the introduction of data security standards for payment cards?
secenekler: A) It helps achieve the holistic protection of information assets in the industry.
B) It deters hackers from committing crimes related to card payments.
C) It enables a wider range of more sophisticated payment methods.
D) It optimizes budget allocation for cybersecurity in each organization.
dogru_cevap: A) It helps achieve the holistic protection of information assets in the industry.

soru: Which of the following should an information security manager establish FIRST to ensure security-related activities are adequately monitored?
secenekler: A) Regular reviews of system logs
B) Accountability for security functions
C) Procedures for security assessments
D) Schedules for internal audits
dogru_cevap: B) Accountability for security functions

soru: Which of the following is the BEST approach for data owners to use when defining access privileges for users?
secenekler: A) Implement an identity and access management (IDM) tool.
B) Adopt user account settings recommended by the vendor.
C) Perform a risk assessment of the users' access privileges.
D) Define access privileges based on user roles.
dogru_cevap: D) Define access privileges based on user roles.

soru: Which of the following is the BEST control to protect customer personal information that is stored in the cloud?
secenekler: A) Strong encryption methods
B) Appropriate data anonymization
C) Strong physical access controls
D) Timely deletion of digital records
dogru_cevap: A) Strong encryption methods

soru: Which of the following is MOST important to include in an enterprise information security policy?
secenekler: A) Acceptable use
B) Security objectives
C) Security metrics
D) Audit trail review requirements
dogru_cevap: B) Security objectives

soru: An information security manager wants to upgrade an organization's workstations to a new operating system version. Which of the following would be MOST helpful to gain senior management support for the upgrade?
secenekler: A) The results of user surveys indicating issues with the current operating system
B) A list of the latest security features in the new operating system
C) A summary of performance improvements in the new operating system
D) An assessment of the current operating system based on risk
dogru_cevap: D) An assessment of the current operating system based on risk

soru: Which of the following is MOST important to define when creating information security management metrics?
secenekler: A) Budget
B) Objectives
C) Policy
D) Benchmarks
dogru_cevap: B) Objectives

soru: A PRIMARY benefit of adopting an information security framework is that it provides:
secenekler: A) standardized security controls.
B) common exploitability indices.
C) credible emerging threat intelligence.
D) security and vulnerability reporting guidelines.
dogru_cevap: A) standardized security controls.

soru: It is MOST important that risk owners understand they are accountable for:
secenekler: A) collaborating with stakeholders to evaluate the effectiveness of controls associated with the risk.
B) reporting risk metrics and control compliance status to the information security manager.
C) escalating control deficiencies associated with the risk to the steering committee for decision making.
D) overseeing and monitoring the effectiveness of controls associated with the risk.
dogru_cevap: D) overseeing and monitoring the effectiveness of controls associated with the risk.

soru: Which of the following is MOST important to include in security incident escalation procedures?
secenekler: A) Recovery procedures
B) Containment procedures
C) Key objectives of the security program
D) Notification criteria
dogru_cevap: D) Notification criteria

soru: An organization has implemented a new email filter to mitigate risk associated with its email system. Who is BEST suited to be the control owner?
secenekler: A) Head of IT department
B) Head of compliance
C) Head of corporate communications
D) Head of information security
dogru_cevap: D) Head of information security

soru: When introducing a new information asset, what is the MOST important responsibility of the asset owner?
secenekler: A) Information backup
B) Information access administration
C) Information disposal
D) Information classification
dogru_cevap: D) Information classification

soru: When establishing an information security governance framework, it is MOST important for an information security manager to understand:
secenekler: A) information security best practices.
B) the corporate culture.
C) risk management techniques.
D) the threat environment.
dogru_cevap: B) the corporate culture.

soru: When updating the information security policy to accommodate a new regulation, the information security manager should FIRST:
secenekler: A) review key risk indicators (KRIs).
B) consult process owners.
C) update key performance indicators (KPIs).
D) perform a gap analysis.
dogru_cevap: D) perform a gap analysis.

soru: Which of the following is the BEST way to align security and business strategies?
secenekler: A) Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) for the business.
B) Integrate information security governance into corporate governance.
C) Ensure the information security program conforms to industry standards.
D) Include security risk as part of ongoing metrics reporting.
dogru_cevap: B) Integrate information security governance into corporate governance.

soru: Which of the following should an information security manager do FIRST when developing a security framework?
secenekler: A) Document security procedures
B) Conduct an asset inventory
C) Update the security policy
D) Perform a gap analysis
dogru_cevap: B) Conduct an asset inventory

soru: A Software as a Service (SaaS) application has been implemented to support a critical business process. Which of the following is MOST important to include within the service level agreement (SLA) to ensure timely response to incidents affecting the application?
secenekler: A) Vendor declarations and warranties
B) Enhanced monitoring of in-scope systems
C) Defined incident response roles and responsibilities
D) Established incident response procedures
dogru_cevap: C) Defined incident response roles and responsibilities

soru: Of the following, who is BEST positioned to perform a business impact analysis (BIA)?
secenekler: A) The information security team
B) Process owners
C) The IT team
D) Business continuity management auditors
dogru_cevap: B) Process owners

soru: Which of the following is the BEST indication of an effective disaster recovery planning process?
secenekler: A) Recovery time objectives (RTOs) are shorter than recovery point objectives (RPOs)
B) Hot sites are required for any declared disaster
C) Post-incident reviews are conducted after each event
D) Chain of custody is maintained throughout the disaster recovery process
dogru_cevap: C) Post-incident reviews are conducted after each event

soru: Which of the following provides the BEST input to determine the level of protection needed for an IT system?
secenekler: A) Vulnerability assessment
B) Asset classification
C) Threat analysis
D) Internal audit findings
dogru_cevap: B) Asset classification

soru: Which of the following should be the FIRST consideration for an information security manager after a security incident has been confirmed?
secenekler: A) Developing incident reporting criteria
B) Executing containment procedures
C) Restoring business operations
D) Determining the root cause
dogru_cevap: B) Executing containment procedures

soru: Which of the following actions will BEST resolve the root cause of a cyber incident involving unauthorized network access due to a critical vulnerability on a web server?
secenekler: A) Improving the patching process
B) Locking accounts with unauthorized access
C) Isolating affected systems
D) Terminating malicious network connections
dogru_cevap: A) Improving the patching process

soru: Following an unsuccessful denial of service (DoS) attack, identified weaknesses should be:
secenekler: A) noted and re-examined later if similar weaknesses are found
B) tracked and reported on until their final resolution
C) quickly resolved and eliminated regardless of cost
D) documented in security awareness programs
dogru_cevap: B) tracked and reported on until their final resolution

soru: Which of the following is an information security manager’s MOST important action during the third-party provider selection process?
secenekler: A) Determining it the third party is sufficiently staffed
B) Performing a network penetration test
C) Analyzing the third party’s existing control environment
D) Consulting with the third party’s clients
dogru_cevap: C) Analyzing the third party’s existing control environment

soru: Which of the following risk assessment findings for an online-only business should be given the HIGHEST priority to address availability concerns?
secenekler: A) The back office system that processes payments to providers has slowed.
B) The web server for the online store was found to be vulnerable to distributed denial of service (DDoS) attacks.
C) Email authentication through a connector to a single sign-on (SSO) service has a history of failure.
D) The access point for the visitor WiFi network has several unpatched vulnerabilities.
dogru_cevap: B) The web server for the online store was found to be vulnerable to distributed denial of service (DDoS) attacks.

soru: At which stage of business continuity planning is risk identification performed?
secenekler: A) Impact analysis
B) Stakeholder meeting
C) Development
D) Project planning
dogru_cevap: A) Impact analysis

soru: An information security team plans to strengthen authentication requirements for a customer-facing site, but there are concerns it will negatively impact the user experience. Which of the following is the information security manager's BEST course of action?
secenekler: A) Refer to industry best practices.
B) Quantify the security risk to the business.
C) Provide security awareness training to customers.
D) Assess business impact against security risk.
dogru_cevap: D) Assess business impact against security risk.

soru: Which of the following is the PRIMARY reason for executive management to be involved in establishing an enterprise’s security management framework?
secenekler: A) To determine the desired state of enterprise security
B) To satisfy auditors’ recommendations for enterprise security
C) To ensure industry best practices for enterprise security are followed
D) To establish the minimum level of controls needed
dogru_cevap: A) To determine the desired state of enterprise security

soru: Which of the following is MOST important for an information security manager to consider when determining whether data should be stored?
secenekler: A) Type and nature of data
B) Business requirements
C) Data storage limitations
D) Data protection regulations
dogru_cevap: B) Business requirements

soru: A business unit recently integrated the organization’s new strong password policy into its business application which requires users to reset passwords every 30 days. The help desk is now flooded with password reset requests. Which of the following is the information security manager’s BEST course of action to address this situation?
secenekler: A) Conduct a business impact analysis (BIA)
B) Provide end-user training
C) Escalate to senior management
D) Continue to enforce the policy
dogru_cevap: B) Provide end-user training

soru: Which of the following is the MOST important objective when planning an incident response program?
secenekler: A) Minimizing business impact
B) Managing resources
C) Recovering from a disaster
D) Ensuring IT resiliency
dogru_cevap: A) Minimizing business impact

soru: Which of the following considerations is MOST important when selecting a third-party intrusion detection system (IDS) vendor?
secenekler: A) The vendor’s proposal aligns with the objectives of the organization
B) The vendor’s proposal allows for contract modification during technology refresh cycles
C) The vendor’s proposal requires the provider to have a business continuity plan (BCP)
D) The vendor’s proposal allows for escrow in the event the third party goes out of business
dogru_cevap: A) The vendor’s proposal aligns with the objectives of the organization

soru: A financial institution is planning to develop a new mobile application. Which of the following is the BEST time to begin assessments of the application’s security compliance?
secenekler: A) During user acceptance testing (UAT)
B) During regulatory review
C) During the design phase
D) During static code analysis
dogru_cevap: C) During the design phase

soru: When considering a new security initiative, which of the following should be done prior to the development of a business case?
secenekler: A) Conduct a risk assessment
B) Conduct a benchmarking exercise
C) Perform a cost-benefit analysis
D) Identify resource requirements
dogru_cevap: A) Conduct a risk assessment

soru: Which of the following BEST demonstrates the potential for successful business continuity in the event of a disaster?
secenekler: A) Tabletop exercises
B) Awareness training assessments
C) Disaster recovery tests
D) Checklist reviews
dogru_cevap: A) Tabletop exercises

soru: Which of the following is an essential practice for workstations used to conduct a forensic investigation?
secenekler: A) A documented chain of custody log is kept for the workstations
B) The workstations are only accessed by members of the forensics team
C) Only forensics-related software is installed on the workstations
D) The workstations are backed up and hardened on a regular basis
dogru_cevap: B) The workstations are only accessed by members of the forensics team

soru: Which of the following components of the risk assessment process should be reviewed FIRST to gain an understanding of the scope of an emerging risk within an organization?
secenekler: A) Risk categorization
B) Asset identification
C) Control evaluation
D) Risk treatment
dogru_cevap: B) Asset identification

soru: An information security manager has been tasked with implementing a security solution that provides insight into potential security incidents Which of the following BEST supports this activity?
secenekler: A) Intrusion detection system (IDS)
B) Security information and event management (SIEM)
C) Data loss prevention system (DLP)
D) User behavior analytics
dogru_cevap: B) Security information and event management (SIEM)

soru: Which of the following is MOST important for the information security manager to confirm when reviewing an incident response plan?
secenekler: A) The plan includes a requirement for post-incident review
B) The plan is based on a business impact analysis (BIA)
C) The plan is stored at backup recovery locations
D) The plan is readily available to provide to auditors.
dogru_cevap: B) The plan is based on a business impact analysis (BIA)

soru: Unintentional behavior by an employee caused a major data loss incident. Which of the following is the BEST way for the information security manager to prevent recurrence within the organization?
secenekler: A) Improve the security awareness training program
B) Communicate consequences for future instances
C) Implement compensating controls
D) Enhance the data loss prevention (DLP) solution
dogru_cevap: A) Improve the security awareness training program

soru: Exceptions to a security policy should be approved based PRIMARILY on:
secenekler: A) results of a cost-benefit analysis.
B) risk appetite.
C) security incident classification.
D) industry best practices.
dogru_cevap: B) risk appetite.

soru: When developing a business case for a new security initiative, an information security manager should FIRST:
secenekler: A) conduct a feasibility study.
B) calculate the total cost of ownership (TCO).
C) perform a cost-benefit analysis.
D) define the issues to be addressed.
dogru_cevap: D) define the issues to be addressed.

soru: A proposal designed to gain buy-in from senior management for a new security project will be MOST effective if it includes:
secenekler: A) historical data of reported incidents.
B) analysis of current threat landscape.
C) industry benchmarking gap analysis.
D) projected return on investment (ROI).
dogru_cevap: D) projected return on investment (ROI).

soru: Which of the following is MOST important for an information security steering committee to ensure?
secenekler: A) Funding is available for information security projects.
B) Information security is managed as a business critical issue.
C) Periodic information security audits are conducted.
D) Resources used for information security projects are minimized.
dogru_cevap: B) Information security is managed as a business critical issue.

soru: An organization experienced a breach which was successfully contained and remediated. Based on industry regulations, the breach needs to be communicated externally. What should the information security manager do NEXT?
secenekler: A) Refer to the privacy policy.
B) Refer to the incident response plan.
C) Send out a breach notification to all parties involved.
D) Contact the board of directors.
dogru_cevap: B) Refer to the incident response plan.

soru: Which of the following is the BEST defense against a brute force attack?
secenekler: A) Discretionary access control
B) Multi-factor authentication (MFA)
C) Mandatory access control
D) Time-of-day restrictions
dogru_cevap: B) Multi-factor authentication (MFA)

soru: Which of the following is MOST important to verify during a test of an organization's incident response process?
secenekler: A) Whether incident response team members know their responsibilities
B) Whether senior management endorses the incident response process
C) Whether users know which numbers to call in the call tree
D) Whether incident response team members are cross-trained
dogru_cevap: A) Whether incident response team members know their responsibilities

soru: An intrusion prevention system (IPS) has reported a significant increase in the number of hacking attempts over the past month, though no systems have actually been compromised. Which of the following should the information security manager do FIRST?
secenekler: A) Tune the IPS to address false positives.
B) Report the increase in hacking attempts to senior management.
C) Validate the events identified by the IPS.
D) Update security awareness training.
dogru_cevap: C) Validate the events identified by the IPS.

soru: The likelihood of a successful intrusion is a function of:
secenekler: A) threat and vulnerability levels.
B) design and redundancy of network perimeter controls.
C) configuration and maintenance of log monitoring system.
D) opportunity and asset value.
dogru_cevap: A) threat and vulnerability levels.

soru: Which of the following is the BEST evidence that senior management supports the information security program?
secenekler: A) The information security manager reports to the chief risk officer (CRO)
B) A reduction in information security costs
C) Consistent enforcement of information security policies
D) A high level of information security risk acceptance
dogru_cevap: C) Consistent enforcement of information security policies

soru: During incident recovery, which of the following is the BEST approach to ensure the eradication of traces hidden by an attacker?
secenekler: A) Reinstall the system from the original source.
B) Perform continuous monitoring until validation is achieved.
C) Prohibit use of the account suspected to be compromised.
D) Conduct a forensic investigation to acquire evidence.
dogru_cevap: A) Reinstall the system from the original source.

soru: Which of the following BEST enables the effectiveness of an information security training program for new employees?
secenekler: A) New employees are required to acknowledge the information security policy.
B) New employees must complete a security assessment after training.
C) Information security training precedes all other onboarding training.
D) The training is specific to new employees' job functions.
dogru_cevap: D) The training is specific to new employees' job functions.

soru: An information security manager has learned of an increasing trend in attacks that use phishing emails impersonating an organization's CEO in an attempt to commit wire transfer fraud. Which of the following is the BEST way to reduce the risk associated with this type of attack?
secenekler: A) Temporarily suspend wire transfers for the organization.
B) Provide awareness training to staff responsible for wire transfers.
C) Disable emails for staff responsible for wire transfers.
D) Provide awareness training to the CEO for this type of phishing attack.
dogru_cevap: B) Provide awareness training to staff responsible for wire transfers.

soru: Which of the following is the BEST indication of effective information security governance?
secenekler: A) Comprehensive security policies reflect organizational objectives.
B) Information security is integrated into organizational processes.
C) The information security program follows industry best practices.
D) An information security risk register is maintained.
dogru_cevap: B) Information security is integrated into organizational processes.

soru: A data loss prevention (DLP) tool has flagged personally identifiable information (PII) during transmission. Which of the following should the information security manager do FIRST?
secenekler: A) Validate the scope and impact with the business process owner.
B) Escalate the issue to senior management.
C) Review and validate the rules within the DLP system.
D) Initiate the incident response plan.
dogru_cevap: A) Validate the scope and impact with the business process owner.

soru: Which of the following is MOST likely to require an organization to update its business continuity plan (BCP)?
secenekler: A) Successful BCP testing results
B) Increases in information security risk trends
C) Multiple changes in organizational leadership
D) Major changes in the business operating environment
dogru_cevap: D) Major changes in the business operating environment

soru: Which of the following is the GREATEST benefit of performing a tabletop exercise of the business continuity plan (BCP)?
secenekler: A) It helps in assessing the availability of compatible backup hardware.
B) It identifies appropriate follow-up work to address shortcomings in the plan.
C) It provides a low-cost method of assessing the BCP’s completeness.
D) It allows for greater participation and planning from the business side.
dogru_cevap: B) It identifies appropriate follow-up work to address shortcomings in the plan.

soru: Which of the following is the BEST approach for encouraging business units to assume their roles and responsibilities in an information security program?
secenekler: A) Engage an independent security audit.
B) Perform a risk assessment.
C) Conduct an awareness program for senior management.
D) Develop controls and countermeasures.
dogru_cevap: C) Conduct an awareness program for senior management.

soru: Which of the following is MOST influential in driving the effectiveness of an information security program?
secenekler: A) Policies and standards
B) Organizational risk appetite
C) Information security metrics
D) Organizational culture
dogru_cevap: D) Organizational culture

soru: The MAIN reason for having senior management review and approve an information security strategic plan is to ensure:
secenekler: A) compliance with legal and regulatory requirements.
B) the plan aligns with corporate governance.
C) staff participation in information security efforts.
D) the organization has the required funds to implement the plan.
dogru_cevap: B) the plan aligns with corporate governance.

soru: Which of the following is the GREATEST risk associated with a poorly trained incident response team responding to a major incident?
secenekler: A) Separation of duty violations
B) Loss of confidential information
C) Evidence contamination
D) Failure to escalate to senior management
dogru_cevap: C) Evidence contamination

soru: Which of the following is the PRIMARY preventive method to mitigate risks associated with privileged accounts?
secenekler: A) Eliminate privileged accounts.
B) Perform periodic certification of access to privileged accounts.
C) Provide privileged account access only to users who need it.
D) Frequently monitor activities on privileged accounts.
dogru_cevap: C) Provide privileged account access only to users who need it.

soru: Which of the following BEST enables an incident response team to determine appropriate actions during an initial investigation?
secenekler: A) Technical capabilities of the team
B) Feedback from affected departments
C) Historical data from past incidents
D) Procedures for incident triage
dogru_cevap: D) Procedures for incident triage

soru: An organization’s service desk has reported that a PC is displaying a message with the phrase "your personal files are encrypted." Which of the following should be done FIRST?
secenekler: A) Analyze the compromised PC to determine the root cause.
B) Isolate the compromised PC from the network.
C) Meet with the security team to identify related assets.
D) Update all security endpoints to the most current versions.
dogru_cevap: B) Isolate the compromised PC from the network.

soru: When multiple Internet intrusions on a server are detected, the PRIMARY concern of the information security manager should be to ensure:
secenekler: A) the incident is reported to senior management.
B) the integrity of evidence is preserved.
C) the server is unplugged from power.
D) forensic investigation software is loaded on the server.
dogru_cevap: B) the integrity of evidence is preserved.

soru: Which of the following groups is MOST important to involve in the development of information security procedures?
secenekler: A) Audit management
B) Senior management
C) End users
D) Operational units
dogru_cevap: D) Operational units

soru: Which of the following would be MOST useful to determine the current status of an information security program's maturity level?
secenekler: A) Business impact analysis (BIA)
B) Cost-benefit analysis
C) Benchmark analysis
D) Risk assessment
dogru_cevap: C) Benchmark analysis

soru: The MOST significant outcome obtained from conducting a business impact analysis (BIA) is improved:
secenekler: A) employee awareness.
B) disaster recovery planning.
C) IT capacity planning.
D) budgeting.
dogru_cevap: B) disaster recovery planning.

soru: Which of the following BEST indicates ongoing senior management commitment to the organization's information security strategy?
secenekler: A) An efficient incident response program
B) Established key performance indicators (KPIs)
C) A comprehensive security awareness training program
D) Adequate funding for the information security program
dogru_cevap: D) Adequate funding for the information security program

soru: Which of the following is MOST important for the information security manager to include when presenting changes in the security risk profile to senior management?
secenekler: A) Performance measures for existing controls
B) Number of false positives
C) Security training test results
D) Industry benchmarks
dogru_cevap: A) Performance measures for existing controls

soru: Which of the following is the MOST important objective when recommending controls?
secenekler: A) Ensuring implementation costs are approved
B) Identifying business processes the controls can support
C) Reducing the risk to an acceptable level
D) Minimizing the impact to business processes
dogru_cevap: C) Reducing the risk to an acceptable level

soru: Which of the following should an organization do FIRST upon learning that a subsidiary is located in a country where civil unrest has just begun?
secenekler: A) Invoke the incident response plan.
B) Assess changes in the risk profile.
C) Conduct security awareness training.
D) Activate the disaster recovery plan (DRP).
dogru_cevap: B) Assess changes in the risk profile.

soru: After updating password standards, an information security manager is alerted by various application administrators that the applications they support are incapable of enforcing these standards. The information security manager's FIRST course of action should be to:
secenekler: A) evaluate the cost of replacing the applications.
B) reevaluate the standards.
C) determine the potential impact.
D) implement compensating controls.
dogru_cevap: C) determine the potential impact.

soru: Which of the following is a PRIMARY responsibility of a data owner?
secenekler: A) Data backup
B) Data classification
C) Data quality
D) Data storage
dogru_cevap: B) Data classification

soru: Which of the following is MOST helpful for retaining the support of executive management for an information security program?
secenekler: A) Forming an information security steering committee to provide oversight of the program
B) Providing regular performance reports on the effectiveness of the program
C) Including satisfaction with information security in employee engagement surveys
D) Developing business cases to justify continued expenses for security awareness
dogru_cevap: B) Providing regular performance reports on the effectiveness of the program

soru: When performing a business impact analysis (BIA), which of the following is the MOST important reason to determine the maximum tolerable downtime (MTD)?
secenekler: A) To determine the data needed for a timely recovery
B) To assist in developing recovery strategies
C) To facilitate selection of the technologies needed to recover
D) To establish resources needed for a successful recovery
dogru_cevap: B) To assist in developing recovery strategies

soru: Which of the following processes should remain internal when outsourcing IT operations?
secenekler: A) Authorization management
B) Data encryption
C) Log monitoring
D) Incident management
dogru_cevap: A) Authorization management

soru: An organization plans to adopt a DevOps approach for innovative application development. Which of the following should be the information security manager's MOST important consideration with regard to the information security strategy?
secenekler: A) Risk profile may change with the new approach.
B) The identified framework may not be appropriate.
C) Security policies may need to be revised.
D) Security staff may lack software coding skills.
dogru_cevap: A) Risk profile may change with the new approach.

soru: Which of the following is the MOST important reason to integrate nonrepudiation into the design of user authentication?
secenekler: A) To ensure there are no conflicts when changing database records
B) To ensure users cannot escalate their own access privileges
C) To ensure users cannot alter log records within the system
D) To ensure actions can be traced to specific users
dogru_cevap: D) To ensure actions can be traced to specific users

soru: A significant risk was identified within a core business function. Budget constraints do not allow for effective remediation. Who should be accountable for selecting the appropriate risk treatment?
secenekler: A) Data custodian
B) Data owner
C) Security officer
D) Senior management
dogru_cevap: D) Senior management

soru: An information security manager is building a business case to support an investment in a next generation firewall. Which of the following would BEST maximize the effectiveness of the business case?
secenekler: A) Comparing inherent risk to residual risk
B) Aligning proof-of-concept with the information security strategy
C) Ensuring return on investment (ROI) is included
D) Comparing costs between the new solution and the current firewall
dogru_cevap: A) Comparing inherent risk to residual risk
